title: Release of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificate at the End of the Requirement
content:
**Who may request a release.** A release request for a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate is made only by the named insured or the filed driver personally. On who is asking, the caller's own statement is the authority, tied to the filing whose release is requested.

**Timing of the release SR-26.**

- A release request received before the required-through date is recorded, but no SR-26 is sent until that date.
- A filing whose state order gives no required-through date is released only after the customer provides the state's letter ending the requirement. The desk cannot evaluate that letter and refers it.

**Moving to another carrier is not a release.** A request to drop the certificate because the customer is moving it to another carrier is not a release. The certificate continues until the backing term itself ends.

### Hypothetical requests

| Request | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Filed driver asks for a release ten days before the required-through date | recorded; no SR-26 until the required-through date |
| Named insured asks for a release on a filing whose state order gave no required-through date, without a state letter | not released |
| Same request with the state's letter ending the requirement | the desk refers the letter |
| Customer asks to drop the certificate because coverage is moving to another carrier | not a release; the certificate continues until the backing term ends |
| A relative calls on the filed driver's behalf | not a release request |
